program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((bg (at g 0 0))
                  (dot (find-first (lambda (p) (!= (at g (fst p) (snd p)) bg))
                                   (flatmap (lambda (r)
                                              (map (lambda (c) (cons r c)) (range 0 w)))
                                            (range 0 h))))
                  (dr (fst dot))
                  (dc (snd dot))
                  (anti (= dr dc))
                  (tc-c (if anti (- w 1) 0))
                  (bc-c (if anti 0 (- w 1))))
             (cellmap g
                      (r c v)
                      (let ((v v))
                        (if (!= v bg)
                            v
                            (if (or
                                  (and (= c dc) (< r dr))
                                  (and
                                    (zero? r)
                                    (>= c (min dc tc-c))
                                    (<= c (max dc tc-c)))
                                  (and (= c dc) (> r dr))
                                  (and
                                    (= r (- h 1))
                                    (>= c (min dc bc-c))
                                    (<= c (max dc bc-c))))
                                1
                                v))))))))
